end.summary:
Discussed the role of the judiciary in society.
Vihaan identified criminal and civil cases through examples.
They asked about appeals, the High Court, benches, and courtrooms.
They requested drawings or photos to support the explanations.
Teach-back was not passed by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised sorting examples into criminal and civil cases and explored how appeals and High Courts fit into the judiciary. They explained their thinking using examples such as bicycle theft, rent disputes, and unpaid contract money. They were still unsure about whether a case could involve both civil and criminal parts, and about the meaning of a court bench; these points were not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use two everyday scenarios and ask Vihaan to label each as civil or criminal and explain why.
